text: 🇲🇽✊ "Electricity is not a privilege or a commodity. It is a right." "In this government, electricity is not understood as a privilege or as a commodity — it is understood as a right tied to social justice and the wellbeing of the Mexican people." — Emilia Esther Calleja, Director of CFE, Mañanera, June 17, 2026 CFE plans 45,000 electrification projects to reach 99.99% national coverage by 2028 — more than triple the works of the 2006–2018 neoliberal sexenios. Investment: 21.377 billion pesos. The state runs the grid. That's why it can be a right.

🇲🇽🌎 "May the people of Colombia win." Asked about Colombia's presidential election, Sheinbaum kept it to one line. — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 17, 2026 No endorsements. No interventions. Just a wish: that the people win. The same principle of non-intervention Mexico extends to Cuba, Venezuela, Bolivia. It applies in the other direction too — Mexico expects the same respect for its own elections.

The 60-year US blockade has been condemned by the UN General Assembly every year for over three decades. Mexico keeps saying it out loud.

🇲🇽🔍 39 lives saved every day. "39 fewer daily homicides than in September 2024. 39 lives, 39 Mexicans who did not die from violence. 39 lives saved each day. This is a historic figure." — Claudia Sheinbaum, Mañanera, June 17, 2026 Mexico's homicide rate keeps dropping — even while hosting the World Cup. The strategy: address root causes, invest in youth, coordinate intelligence. Not mano dura. Not militarization for show. Justice social as security policy.

🇲🇽🏭 ACTIVIDAD INDUSTRIAL MEXICANA +1.8% ANUAL EN ABRIL — CONSTRUCCIÓN SALTA +10.2%

INEGI's Monthly Industrial Activity Indicator (IMAI) climbed 1.8% year-over-year in April 2026 — Mexico's highest industrial growth print since November 2023.

The +2.1% monthly gain was the largest since March 2021, far exceeding market forecasts. Construction led with +10.2% annual growth and +7.6% month-over-month, swinging from a -4.4% contraction in March to a double-digit advance.

Manufacturing dipped -0.3% annual as US-bound exports softened under tariff noise. Mining +3.4%; energy/water/gas -0.4%.

US press writes Mexico's economic obituary every month. INEGI's hard data keeps proving them wrong.

Source: El Financiero / El Economista

🇲🇽🌀 CICLÓN TROPICAL FORMA EN GOLFO — TAMAULIPAS Y TEXAS EN ALERTA SIMULTÁNEA

A potential tropical cyclone is developing in the Gulf of Mexico off the Tamaulipas-Texas border. Sustained winds around 45 km/h, gusts over 60 km/h, system advancing at 9 km/h to the northeast.

CONAGUA warns of "extremely elevated flooding risk in coastal lowlands" and high ocean waves on both sides of the border. The SMN is monitoring atmospheric instability hour by hour.

Civil Protection activated temporary shelter monitoring across Tamaulipas; residents told to secure loose structures and limit unnecessary travel.

Climate does not recognize borders. Mexican Civil Protection prepares; FEMA was gutted by Trump in March.

Source: Regeneración

🇲🇽📚 CNTE TO SHEINBAUM: "LA MESA NO ESTÁ ROTA" — TEACHERS DEMAND DIRECT TALK

Section 9 leader Pedro Hernández today: "the negotiation table is not broken; if we are summoned, we are here." CETEG leader Elvira Veleces from Guerrero added: "the ball is in their court."

Sheinbaum has routed the talks through Segob and SEP; CNTE insists on a presidential audience. The Zócalo encampment continues, and CETEG is weighing a permanent block of Paseo de la Reforma between Independence Monument and Torre del Caballito.

This is unfinished 4T business — repeal of the 2007 ISSSTE pension law, wage backpay, real pension reform. Negotiation, not confrontation.

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🎶 VERACRUZ MOVES 900 MDP WITH SALSA FEST — 580,000 PEOPLE, ZERO VIOLENCE

Salsa Fest 2026 drew 580,000 attendees over three days in Veracruz-Boca del Río, generating over 900 million pesos in economic impact, 100% hotel occupancy, and 97% capacity at Heriberto Jara Corona airport.

Free event. Visitors came from all 32 Mexican states plus the US, Latin America, and Europe.

Governor Rocío Nahle: "such festivals are part of a permanent strategy to strengthen tourism through year-round artistic and recreational events."

This is what cultural sovereignty looks like — Afro-Caribbean music, packed venues, families safe in a port the US press still calls "ungovernable."

Source: Contralínea

🇲🇽🌎 SHEINBAUM SANCTIONS AMLO'S COUSIN FOR INSULTING TRUMP — "NO REPRESENTA AL GOBIERNO"

Manuela Obrador, Bienestar delegate in Chiapas and AMLO's cousin, called Trump a "tyrannical misogynist and disgusting guy" at a Morena rally in Palenque.

Sheinbaum confirmed today she will be sanctioned: "she does not represent the sentiment of the government." A second investigation opened on whether she illegally held two positions while campaigning at a partisan event.

Mexico answers Trump's hostility through institutional channels, trade negotiation, and diplomatic discipline — not improvised insults from federal officials. Sovereignty is also self-control.

Source: La Jornada
